Phase 20 is in positional-phase20.tar.gz, which holds 5 modified files. Extract it at the repo root, then delete these three files:

sh
git rm app/src/main/res/font/bold.ttf app/src/main/res/values/integers.xml app/src/main/res/raw/keep.xml
What changed

Unused resources: I worked out which resources are reachable from the manifest, Kotlin code (not tests) and build.gradle, following references between resource files. Earlier phases had already removed most unused resources, so only a few were left. These are now removed:
the colorAccentRipple attribute;
colorAccent, in both the day and night colours;
the animation_duration integer;
the bold font;
raw/keep.xml, which only kept ic_trail_line, and that drawable is referenced directly in code anyway.
build.gradle:
lint { fatal.add('UnusedResources') } makes lintVitalRelease fail on any unused resource. That covers both CI and assembleRelease.
The generated versionName string and resValues true are removed. Settings reads BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME, so lint would have flagged that string.
The instrumentation runner (there are no instrumented tests) and vectorDrawables.useSupportLibrary (pointless at minSdk 24 without AppCompat) are removed.
README: phase 20 is marked done, and the CI section says lint now fails on unused resources. Phase 21 is next: about 17 MB of the drawables are the splash-screen art vectors (launcher_day_* and launcher_night_*). Their coordinates will be rounded to fewer decimal places to cut APK size and loading time.
The translations had no strings missing from the default language, so no translation files needed changes. I couldn’t run lint here because there’s no Android SDK. If CI reports an unused resource that my check missed, paste the lint report and I’ll fix it.

Worth checking on the Nord: Settings should still show the app version.
